about: Measured design facts from design_audit.py. Each finding cites a guideline and carries the measured numbers; the plan turns them into design suggestions the user keeps or applies. Sizes are logical px. screen 'all' means manifest-wide (tokens or the whole design). also_in lists other places with the same finding as <screen>/<state> ('tokens' for token values). Sorted by severity, then category: accessibility, ux, states, localization, platform, consistency.

findings.detail: link "Forgot password?" has a touch target of height 20 px: under Material 48 dp and HIG 44 pt; passes WCAG 2.5.8 by its spacing exception.
findings.guideline: Material 3 accessibility: touch targets at least 48 x 48 dp; Apple HIG: at least 44 x 44 pt. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), level AA: 24 x 24 CSS px, unless a 24 px circle centered on each undersized target does not intersect another target or its circle (spacing exception), or the target is an inline link in a sentence, among other exceptions

findings.detail: Colors #3D5AFE and #3E5BFE differ by delta E 0.73; they read as one color.
findings.guideline: Common design-token practice: colors within CIE76 delta E 3 are hard to tell apart and usually mean one intended color; Material 3 assigns each purpose one color role
